description: Fires only when column 4 holds exactly two stones, so the next stone there lands at row 3 (cell (2,4)). Among those positions it fires mainly when the columns on either side (3 and 5) are stacked up beside that empty cell, and most strongly right after the opponent has played the second stone in column 4. The colours of the nearby stones matter (who is to move), but I found no simple rule for that.
effect: Weak and inconsistent. In the strongest cases, zeroing the unit lowers the column-4 move by 4-12 points; elsewhere it shifts columns 3-5 by about 5 points either way.
notes: Col4 height==2 alone: recall 1.00, precision 0.22 (F1 0.36). Adding col5>=2: F1 0.49. Flank-crowding count: F1 0.48. A their-minus-mine colour count around (2,4) failed (F1 0.23). Best (p5: flank count + col5 + last move col 4): F1 0.499, P 0.38, R 0.73, sim share 0.58. Minimal pairs show strong colour/side-to-move dependence: one extra far stone flips 3.1 to about -0.5, and a second one restores it. The rest is likely nonlinear or polysemantic. Synthesis reaches 10.04 > dev max 9.51.
